title: Map filter reduce chain
starterCode:
const nums = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
const result = nums
  .filter(n => n % 2 === 0)
  .map(n => n * 10)
  .reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
return result
solution:
const nums = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
const result = nums
  .filter(n => n % 2 === 0)
  .map(n => n * 10)
  .reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
return result
